feature.name: iCalendar recurrence (rrule) core
feature.description: Extract python-dateutil rrule/rruleset/rrulestr recurrence iteration for naive datetimes without timezone, general parser, or relativedelta machinery.
included_behaviors: rrule iteration with freq, interval, count, until, and BY* filters
rrulestr for RRULE lines with naive iCalendar date values
weekday constants MO..SU and freq constants
excluded_behaviors: original dateutil package import at runtime

entanglement.description: Recurrence couples RFC grammar parsing, calendar bitmask state, leap years, setpos/weekday interactions, generator caching, and rruleset merging.
signals: rrulestr maps RFC tokens to constructor kwargs
BYSETPOS interacts with BYDAY monthly masks

output.import: import featurelifted; from featurelifted import rrule, rruleset, rrulestr, YEARLY, MONTHLY, WEEKLY, DAILY, MO, TU, WE, TH, FR, SA, SU

public_spec.title: iCalendar recurrence (rrule) core
public_spec.summary: Extract a task-scoped subset of `dateutil` into a standalone `featurelifted` package.

behaviors.text: The extracted feature must support this observable behavior: rrule iteration with freq, interval, count, until, and BY* filters. Required observable cases include weekly byweekday filter; count stops iteration; bysetpos last friday; invalid rrulestr freq raises.
The extracted feature must support this observable behavior: rruleset include rules with EXDATE/RDATE (naive). Required observable cases include rrulestr parses monthly rule; rruleset exdate skips.

The extracted feature must support this observable behavior: rrulestr for RRULE lines with naive iCalendar date values. Required observable cases include monthly rrule yields dates; rrulestr parses monthly rule; invalid rrulestr freq raises; rrulestr byday token.
The extracted feature must support this observable behavior: BYEASTER offsets via easter helper. Required observable cases include byeaster occurrence.
The extracted feature must support this observable behavior: weekday constants MO..SU and freq constants. Required observable cases include bysetpos last friday.

The package exposes the required task API paths `featurelifted.rrule`, `featurelifted.rruleset`, `featurelifted.rrulestr`, `featurelifted.YEARLY`, `featurelifted.MONTHLY`, `featurelifted.WEEKLY`, `featurelifted.DAILY`, `featurelifted.MO`, `featurelifted.TU`, `featurelifted.WE`, `featurelifted.TH`, `featurelifted.FR`, and 2 listed members with the kinds and callable signatures listed in this contract.

exclusions: original dateutil package import at runtime
